info.title: Tentaflake host environment API
info.summary: Authoritative v1 contract; backend is not implemented or accepted.
info.description: This schema owns wire types and routes for the future host API. It is not a working host service, CLI implementation or live-runtime acceptance. Read docs/19-host-api.md for trust, lifecycle and recovery semantics. The existing UI must migrate its provisional contract to this schema.

get.description: Public minimal discovery only. No user, grant, resource, readiness detail or credential is disclosed. apiVersions identifies contract negotiation, not runtime acceptance. backend=unavailable is mandatory until an API implementation exists.

get.summary: Read authenticated identity and exact grants
get.description: Identity, grants, revisions and mutation epoch are server-owned. An unlisted grant is denied; resource IDs must match exactly. Session data is never persisted in browser local storage.

post.summary: Exchange a configured operator login token
post.description: Private same-origin HTTPS only. Validate exact Origin and Host and JSON content type; no CORS. Rate-limit before token verification. Rotate session and CSRF identifiers on success. The bootstrap token is runtime-only, single-use, never an environment/provider credential; failures do not reveal identities. Sets __Host-tentaflake-session with Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/ and no Domain. Only advertised methods are enabled.

delete.summary: Revoke this session and its stream attachments
delete.description: Idempotent session revocation; invalidate cookie and CSRF token, close terminal/log/event attachments immediately. Running environments/terminal processes follow independent lifecycle policy; logout does not silently delete workspaces.

get.summary: Discover an enabled OIDC login flow
get.description: Returns unsupported unless an operator configured OIDC. Authorization and callback routes use server-generated state, nonce, PKCE and an allowlisted issuer/redirect path. No arbitrary redirect target or credential is accepted.
Redirect only to the configured issuer; set a short-lived Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax login-state cookie. Require an exact same-origin navigation and reject arbitrary redirect/issuer parameters.

Validate single-use state, PKCE, nonce, signature, issuer, audience and timestamps before mapping the configured owner identity. Set the same protected session cookie and redirect to the fixed same-origin UI path. Reject unconfigured identities; no automatic administrator enrollment. Never log code, state or tokens.

get.summary: Read granted features and bounded host limits
get.description: Availability is readiness, not authority: each action still needs an exact server-side grant. Omitted features are denied. container shares the host kernel and is not strict isolation. guest-kernel remains unsupported/unready without usable KVM and accepted backend evidence. Limits include host/Research reserves and apply across all environments, not per request only.

post.summary: Validate a disabled declarative catalog draft
post.description: No downloads or execution. Bind preview to owner, revisions, expiry and immutable content digest; imported entries remain disabled until separate operator review.

post.summary: Store the exact reviewed disabled catalog draft
post.description: Commit only the same owner-bound unexpired preview at current policy/catalog/grant revisions. Imported declarations never grant authority or establish artifact/runtime acceptance. Refuse any preview containing an error; imported blocks remain disabled after storage.

post.summary: Save a reusable configuration without activating it
post.description: The configured host create-preset policy explicitly specifies which exact grants to issue for the new preset; atomically issue those grants with creation. No host-grant inheritance; absent create policy is forbidden. Refresh the session grant revision after success.

put.summary: Replace one preset at its exact revision
put.description: Existing environments retain their pinned configuration; saving a preset never reconfigures or starts them.

delete.summary: Delete one preset at its exact revision

post.summary: Resolve an owner-bound policy and catalog snapshot
post.description: Side-effect-free bounded planning. No reservations, downloads, host rebuild, activation or provider calls. Validate current exact grants, reviewed digests, quotas and aggregate reserves. A valid plan is not a resource reservation or runtime acceptance. Never downgrade guest-kernel to container. Expire after at most 300 seconds; commit repeats admission under a host-wide lock. Propose concrete new environment/workspace IDs and exact grants using an explicitly configured host creation-policy template at the pinned policy revision. These proposed grants confer no authority before commit; absent policy is forbidden. Retained workspaces keep their existing owner/grants.

Durably claim the scoped key before creating resources. Revalidate plan owner, expiry, exact policy/catalog/grant/host revisions, retained-workspace revision, current readiness and aggregate ceilings atomically. startAfterCreate also needs environments.startOnCreate and environments.start. Default stopped intent is explicit false. No host rebuild/activation. Fail plan_stale on changed authority; never silently replace the plan. Atomically issue only the planned exact resource grants from the explicit creation policy with resource creation and ledger receipt; return updated grant revision. startAfterCreate requires its exact proposed start/startOnCreate grants. Proposed IDs are not reservations; collision invalidates the plan.

patch.summary: Rename an environment at its exact revision

delete.summary: Delete an environment with explicit workspace disposition
delete.description: Requires stopped state, no conflicting operation, exact environment revision and workspaces.retain or workspaces.delete on its exact workspace. No default deletion disposition. Retention unbinds the workspace while preserving owner, quota and revision; deletion removes only this managed workspace. Never delete attached/shared state or follow source symlinks.

post.description: Require exact owner/grant/revision and no conflicting operation. Start repeats current policy/readiness/quota admission; stop is always bounded and preserves the workspace. A crash after dispatch becomes unknown/interrupted, never automatic replay.

Require exact owner/grant/revision and no conflicting operation. Start repeats current policy/readiness/quota admission; stop is always bounded and preserves the workspace. A crash after dispatch becomes unknown/interrupted, never automatic replay.

Side-effect-free; bind owner, environment revision, current policy/catalog/grants and expiry. Explain live/restart/recreate/unsupported effects. A recreate must preserve workspace ownership and require explicit stopped state; no silent destructive conversion.

post.summary: Apply exactly the admitted unexpired change preview
post.description: Revalidate all preview bindings and current admission under the mutation lock. Reject unsupported effects, running-state conflicts or changed revisions. No implicit start, stop, workspace deletion or image filesystem conversion.

get.summary: Read the durable status of one owned mutation
get.description: The original authenticated principal may recover its minimal receipt through retained receipt/tombstone authorization, even after its target was deleted. Do not infer resource authority from this access: private result content still requires current grants. Revoked principal/session authentication is denied. Operation receipt and unknown outcomes survive process restarts. Typed result resource references identify created terminals and other resources after a lost response; running/unknown states are not completion evidence.

get.summary: Recover one precisely scoped idempotency record
get.description: Scope is host, authenticated principal, server mutation epoch, HTTP method, canonical target including semantic query and UUID. Do not accept an ownerId from the client. Return absent only after authoritative lookup of a complete healthy current-epoch ledger. Unavailable, corrupt, retired, pruned or ambiguous evidence returns unknown, never an empty list. Recover by exact key; do not infer success from current environment state. Retain minimal original-principal receipt authorization after resource deletion so reconciliation does not depend on the deleted resource grant. This never restores resource access or bypasses session/principal revocation.

delete.description: Must be retained, owned and unbound, with no live transfer/operation attachment. Lock and recheck the revision and binding before deletion. Reject active or foreign workspaces; preserve all other state.

get.summary: List one bounded workspace directory snapshot
get.description: Cursors bind directory revision, owner and path. Revisions changing across pages fail revision_conflict. No symlink traversal; entries may describe symlinks as read-only.

delete.summary: Delete an exact file or empty directory
delete.description: No recursive deletion or root deletion. Require exact entry revision under lock. Refuse symlinks, nonempty directories, special files and mount boundaries. A failed or unknown deletion must not be blindly retried under another key. Strong revision comparison and commit require proven workspace quiescence: stop or fence all environment, terminal, worker and transfer writers. An API mutex alone cannot serialize arbitrary workload writes. Until the backend can prove safe quiescence, refuse mutation with environment_running or unready.

get.summary: Search bounded path metadata in one workspace
get.description: Bound visited entries, result count and wall time; never traverse symlinks, mounts, other workspaces or read file contents as an implicit search side effect.

get.summary: Read metadata and a strong revision
Read one regular file at its exact revision
get.description: Bound by maxEditBytes; larger downloads use the download route and files.download. No symlink, device, socket, mount escape or directory content. Verify If-Match on the opened file and send its strong ETag. Return Content-Disposition: attachment and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; never render workspace HTML at the authenticated origin. Capture an immutable quota-accounted snapshot before streaming; a descriptor on a concurrently writable file is not a stable snapshot.

put.summary: Atomically create or replace one bounded regular file
put.description: Require exactly one of If-Match (replace exact revision) or If-None-Match:* (create only). Enforce maxEditBytes, physical workspace quota and aggregate staging capacity while streaming. Stage inside the same managed filesystem, sync data, compare revision under lock, then atomic rename and durable receipt. Incomplete requests never expose partial content. No symlink traversal or clobber on conflict. Server hash includes exact bytes and precondition. Strong revision comparison and commit require proven workspace quiescence: stop or fence all environment, terminal, worker and transfer writers. An API mutex alone cannot serialize arbitrary workload writes. Until the backend can prove safe quiescence, refuse mutation with environment_running or unready.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: One exact strong ETag; wildcard, weak and multi-value forms rejected. Comparison occurs under the mutation lock.

post.summary: Create one absent directory under an unchanged parent
post.description: If-Match is the parent directory revision. Target must be absent; no recursive parent creation. Root cannot be created. Strong revision comparison and commit require proven workspace quiescence: stop or fence all environment, terminal, worker and transfer writers. An API mutex alone cannot serialize arbitrary workload writes. Until the backend can prove safe quiescence, refuse mutation with environment_running or unready.

post.summary: Atomically move an exact entry to an absent destination
post.description: Lock and compare sourceRevision and destinationParentRevision; target must be absent. No overwrite, cross-workspace move, root move, symlink traversal or moving a directory into itself. Invalidate both parent directory revisions. Strong revision comparison and commit require proven workspace quiescence: stop or fence all environment, terminal, worker and transfer writers. An API mutex alone cannot serialize arbitrary workload writes. Until the backend can prove safe quiescence, refuse mutation with environment_running or unready.

put.summary: Stream one quota-bounded file upload atomically
put.description: Require exactly one of If-Match (replace exact revision) or If-None-Match:* (create only). Enforce maxUploadBytes, physical workspace quota and aggregate staging capacity while streaming. Stage inside the same managed filesystem, sync data, compare revision under lock, then atomic rename and durable receipt. Incomplete requests never expose partial content. No symlink traversal or clobber on conflict. Server hash includes exact bytes and precondition. Upload grant also requires files.write for the exact environment/workspace. Enforce total/idle deadlines; abort and reclaim staging on disconnect, revoke or limit failure. No multipart archive extraction or URL import. Strong revision comparison and commit require proven workspace quiescence: stop or fence all environment, terminal, worker and transfer writers. An API mutex alone cannot serialize arbitrary workload writes. Until the backend can prove safe quiescence, refuse mutation with environment_running or unready.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: One exact strong ETag; wildcard, weak and multi-value forms rejected. Comparison occurs under the mutation lock.

get.description: Requires files.read as well. Stream from an opened checked regular-file descriptor with byte/deadline/concurrency limits; no archive traversal or remote fetch. Refuse Range requests in v1. Send strong ETag, Content-Length, attachment disposition and nosniff; abort if exact snapshot cannot be preserved. Capture an immutable quota-accounted snapshot before streaming; a descriptor on a concurrently writable file is not a stable snapshot.

Artifacts retain producer, exact file revision and digest; content is downloaded through the same granted workspace file path and revision. An artifact label never bypasses file access, quotas or ownership.
Only a running admitted environment supports terminal process sessions; display unknown/exited faithfully. A terminal process is distinct from a browser attachment.

post.summary: Start a bounded terminal process inside one environment
post.description: Require running, admitted environment and exact revision. Start the catalog-approved shell as the environment user, with the same mounts, namespaces, quotas, egress and credentials boundary; never host shell, arbitrary user, argv or environment injection. Bound processes, lifetime and idle expiry.

delete.summary: End one exact owned terminal process
delete.description: If-Match is the terminal revision. Signal only the process group proven to belong to this terminal and environment; bounded termination/escalation. Closing a WebSocket only detaches and never invokes this deletion.

get.summary: Attach an authenticated bounded terminal WebSocket
get.description: Same-origin wss only. Before upgrade/output/input, verify exact configured Host and Origin, the protected session cookie (or independent CLI bearer), active owner grants and terminal/environment binding. Missing Origin is rejected for browser cookie auth. Never put credentials in query strings or subprotocols. Recheck revocation continuously and on frames; close immediately on expiry/revocation. after is an output UTF-8 byte offset at a frame boundary; default current end. Outside retained window returns cursor_expired, never silent loss. Only one writer per terminal; other attachments fail operation_pending. No input replay or reconnect resubmission. Output offsets advance by UTF-8 byte length. Bound frames, backlog, replay window, attachments, read/write rates and idle/total deadlines. A closed connection is not process completion.

Each SSE data field is one LogLine JSON object and id equals cursor. Bound line bytes, rate, duration and replay. Authorize owner/environment before replay and during delivery; close on session expiry/revocation. After or Last-Event-ID may specify the same cursor; conflicting values fail invalid. Expired cursor returns cursor_expired before stream start. Logs are untrusted text, never credentials or HTML. Heartbeats are SSE comments. Disconnect does not imply environment failure.

Each SSE data field is one HostEvent JSON object and id equals cursor. Filter every event and replay against current exact grants; never expose another owner. Last-Event-ID follows the same rules as logs. Bounded replay gap emits resync-required then closes, or cursor_expired before start. session-ended closes immediately. Refetch authoritative state after resync; stream event delivery never grants authority or proves a mutation absent.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-tentaflake-session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque server session. Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; no Domain. Runtime-only state; never put cookie values in URLs, fixtures or local storage.

cliBearer.description: Optional independently configured CLI token maps to the same exact principal/grants. Runtime-only credential input. Requests must not mix cookie and bearer credentials; no authority from Origin alone.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Fresh UUID per intent. Reuse exactly this key, epoch and request only after authoritative recovery; never generate a new key for an unknown outcome.

IdempotencyEpoch.name: Idempotency-Epoch
IdempotencyEpoch.description: Server-owned ledger epoch from Session. Retired or unknown epochs fail closed; refresh session and reconcile old operations before forming a new intent.

CSRF.name: X-Tentaflake-CSRF
CSRF.description: Required for every cookie-authenticated mutation except session creation. Must match the active session; absent/invalid is csrf_failed. Bearer-authenticated CLI requests do not use cookies or this header.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: One exact strong ETag; wildcard, weak and multi-value forms rejected. Comparison occurs under the mutation lock.

After.name: after
After.description: Opaque replay cursor bound to principal, resource, epoch and stream. Unknown/expired cursor fails with cursor_expired; never silently skip missing data.

ETag.description: Exact strong revision ETag for this representation.

OperationId.description: Durably recorded receipt for this mutation, including synchronous mutations. Recover via operations after an uncertain response.

NextCursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor, omitted on the last page. Bound to principal, query and snapshot revision.

RetryAfter.description: Minimum delay in seconds; this never permits replay of an unknown mutation.

CacheControl.description: Sensitive host responses must not be cached.

ContentDisposition.description: Workspace bytes are downloaded, never rendered as application-origin content.

NoSniff.description: Do not infer executable browser content types.

Error.description: Structured fail-closed error. 400 invalid; 401 unauthenticated/expired/revoked; 403 forbidden/CSRF; 404 missing or inaccessible resource; 409 conflict/stale/unknown; 412 revision conflict; 413 too large; 428 missing precondition; 429 bounded capacity/rate; 501 unsupported; 503 unavailable/unready. Request IDs contain no sensitive source. Never return raw diagnostics, credentials or foreign-resource metadata.

WorkspacePath.description: Canonical path relative to the selected workspace. HTTP decoding happens exactly once; residual percent signs, backslashes, dot components, control characters, repeated/trailing separators are rejected. The root is /. This does not authorize symlink traversal.

source.description: Bounded declarative manifest text only. URLs, executable hooks, secrets and implicit network/package acquisition are rejected.
